create_objectfile: create an ObjectFile instance from a binary executable path to inspect its sections and symbols
get_sections_objectfile: get sections from an ObjectFile instance and iterate over their names and addresses
get_symbols_objectfile: get symbols from an ObjectFile instance with caching to access name and address after iteration
get_relocations_section: get relocations from a Section instance and inspect offset, type name, and symbol
cache_section_properties: cache section properties like name, size, contents, and address for later access after expiration
